item.title: Towards precision psychiatry: initial foundations and future directions
item.description:
Representative article figure (not a graphical abstract)

Nature Reviews Drug Discovery, Published online: 24 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41573-026-01509-0

Drug discovery for psychiatric disorders is a slow and challenging process, driven in part by reliance on symptom-based diagnostic criteria that fail to capture the underlying disease biology. In their Perspective, Etkin and co-authors suggest a framework for a precision psychiatry approach, drawing on examples from oncology and neurology and providing initial examples for proof of principle. They discuss important biomarkers that could be used to define patient subpopulations for clinical trials and provide mechanism-based readouts to expedite psychiatric drug development.

item.title: Targeting CDKs in the RNAPII transcription cycle
item.description:
Representative article figure (not a graphical abstract)

Nature Reviews Drug Discovery, Published online: 24 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41573-026-01517-0

Transcriptional CDKs coordinate gene expression throughout the transcription cycle and are increasingly recognized as therapeutic targets. This Review examines their roles in cancer-associated transcriptional dysregulation and highlights emerging strategies to modulate transcriptional CDKs for therapeutic benefit.

item.title: Artificial intelligence in drug discovery — what it is, where we stand and the path forward
item.description:
Representative article figure (not a graphical abstract)

Nature Reviews Drug Discovery, Published online: 07 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41573-026-01496-2

Applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in drug discovery have attracted high interest in recent years, but evidence for clinically relevant impact so far is limited. This Perspective discusses potential reasons, including an insufficient focus on clinical translation during model development and difficulties with applying AI algorithms on conditional life science data, and provides recommendations for the development of AI in drug discovery.
